messages:
deploy-bot: preflight CHECK FAILED for release 2026-03-21T12:40Z — env-parity: k8s secret 'embeddings-keys' referenced by deployment 'inference-proxy' missing in prod. Rollout paused.

sam.engineering: saw this too in canary. staging uses `embeddings-keys-v2`, prod expects `embeddings-keys`. looks like a values overlay mismatch in the helm chart.

maria.ops: @ben-infra can you advise? change window ends in ~25m :hourglass_flowing_sand: — do we backfill or abort?

ben-infra: quick options: 1) backfill secret to prod (copy from staging, scrub audit fields) 2) patch helm values and re-run deploy 3) rollback canary. Backfill is fastest (~10m) but requires approvals. Preference: backfill + pin model variant.

qa_jordan: staging smoke tests were green. prod canary fails auth to S3 for embeddings bucket. snippet from prod canary logs:
```
WARN s3client Unauthorized signing error for embeddings-bucket
ERROR inference-proxy: failed to init embedding layer: missing credentials
```

irene_release: recommendation: backfill secret into prod to restore availability, and pin MODEL_VARIANT to v1.2.3 for this rollout. v1.2.4 introduced a new secret envelope format that staging already migrated to — we don't want to mix variants mid-rollout.

sam.engineering: agree with pin. I'll prepare a tiny helm values override to set MODEL_VARIANT=1.2.3 and open a PR to pin it. Follow-up migration of secret format can be a separate staged rollout.

maria.ops: I'll update the release notes to reflect hotfix + follow-up migration. Proposed blurb: "Hotfix: backfilled embeddings secret to prod; pinned inference-proxy MODEL_VARIANT to v1.2.3. Follow-up: secret-format migration scheduled after verification."

ben-infra: starting copy job now (one-off Job to create prod secret from staging snapshot). applying: 
```
kubectl apply -f infra/backfill/embeddings-secret-backfill-job.yaml
kubectl logs job/embeddings-secret-backfill -f
```

ben-infra: job done, secret created in prod (values redacted). kicking preflight again.

deploy-bot: re-run preflight: OK — env parity satisfied for embeddings secret.

deploy-bot: canary resume triggered for release 2026-03-21T12:40Z.

qa_jordan: re-running smoke tests on prod canary... all checks now passing :white_check_mark: (auth + inference smoke).

irene_release: please include rollback instructions in the notes: how to revert pin and how to re-run backfill job. Also add a feature flag to opt-out of new secret envelope for a short window.

sam.engineering: opened PR #4823 to pin MODEL_VARIANT and add a small runbook link to revert and to re-run backfill job: https://runbook.internal/release/embed-secret-backfill. PTAL @maria.ops @ben-infra

release-bot: changelog entry created: 2026-03-21-hotfix-embeddings-secret-backfill (added by maria.ops).

maria.ops: updated release notes and pushed post-release task to verify secret-format migration (assignee: @sam.engineering). Closing thread once PR merged and post-release verification done. Thanks all. :tada:
